== Description ==

Two people at a commentary desk with a microphone and a laptop, at the [[2022 World Championship]] in Atlanta. The desk has the same black tablecloth as the other streaming-desk photographs from this event. Neither person is yet identified.

== Source and credit ==

* '''Source:''' Star Wars CCG Slack, #worlds-2022, jarjardrinks, 17 October 2022 (14:38 Eastern), posted with the words "Caption this". Original file name: image_from_ios.jpg (1170×2532); Slack file id F046VRFP4LT.
* '''Shared by:''' jarjardrinks (Slack)
* '''Date:''' not recorded (posted 17 October 2022).
* '''Identification:''' Faces are not yet identified. This is a different moment from [[:File:2022 World Championship streaming desk 1.jpg]], [[:File:2022 World Championship streaming desk 2.jpg]] and [[:File:2022 World Championship streaming desk 3.jpg]].

Unknown faces are listed on [[Unidentified event photographs]]; if you recognise someone, please say so on the [https://swccg.com/forum/viewforum.php?f=4 SWCCG Forum] or this File's Talk page.
